recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current build preserves the durable parts of FHIR-13781 after later Pharmacy decisions; any renewed need for chemotherapy/endocrine treatment classification should be handled by a new final tracker rather than by restoring superseded category prose.
issue_request: FHIR-13781 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy request for STU3 MedicationPrescription/MedicationRequest. Although titled around reasonCode/reasonReference, the accepted change was to make MedicationRequest.category repeatable, change the binding to exemplar/example while retaining inpatient/outpatient/community, and add notes allowing categories such as chemotherapy/endocrine treatment types with profile-specific value set binding/invariants.
initial_application: Commit cf35ab7ebcf102964085812bf6e2166fe3eaa11c explicitly applied GF #13781 in the old MedicationRequest spreadsheet source, changing category cardinality from 0..1 to 0..*, changing preferred to example binding, and adding treatment-type/profiling guidance. MedicationPrescription later became MedicationRequest and the source was refactored into current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms the submitter's use case was distinguishing disease indication from endocrine/chemotherapy treatment classification. Later Published issue FHIR-15688 directly revisited MedicationRequest.category, found it overloaded, and resolved to pull category back to inpatient/outpatient/etc. while separating treatment-type handling; commit b87c1a290d removed the chemotherapy/endocrine and invariant-profiling category notes. FHIR-17255 added courseOfTherapyType as a separate therapy-pattern element, and later terminology work restored the category example CodeSystem/ValueSet to core without changing that conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source/fhir.ini includes MedicationRequest, and source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml shows MedicationRequest.category as 0..* with an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationrequest-category. The in-core category CodeSystem/ValueSet retains inpatient, outpatient, and community codes. Re-adding FHIR-13781's treatment-type wording would conflict with later final Pharmacy intent in FHIR-15688.
